title: Output length bound for the query transformation
statement: Let $f$ map finite Boolean strings to finite Boolean strings, and suppose there are natural numbers $C,e$ such that $|f(x)|\le C(|x|+1)^e$ for every finite Boolean string $x$. For any finite Boolean strings $w$ and $t$, the output length of the query transformation applied to $w$ is at most $(2C+3)(|\langle w,t\rangle|+1)^{e+1}$, where $\langle w,t\rangle$ denotes their self-delimiting pair encoding.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps finite Boolean strings to finite Boolean strings
